page.content:
Hive that assimilates ships, worlds, and Picard.

How Borg Collective connects

  • Work: Star Trek: First Contact — First Contact is a Borg assault on Earth's past.
  • Character: Jean-Luc Picard — Picard is assimilated and later hunts the Borg.
  • Concept: Locutus of Borg — Locutus speaks as a voice of the Collective.
  • Character: Seven of Nine — Seven was a drone of the Borg Collective.

What is Borg Collective?

The Borg Collective is the cybernetic hive that cubes across the galaxy, assimilating species and making Picard into Locutus.

Key threads lead to Star Trek: First Contact, Jean-Luc Picard, Locutus of Borg and Seven of Nine.
